text: I asked ChatGPT what I should post about. It asked me ten questions back.
"Give me content ideas" gets you the same ideas as everyone else.
So flip it. Ask it to interview you. Ten questions, one at a time.
About your life, your skills, what you can't stop talking about.
Then ask for three niches only you could own.
Built from your answers. Nobody else can copy that.
Comment NICHE, and I'll send you the exact prompt, plus five more to plan your first ten reels.
